title: Strategy Operations Manager
description:
**Who We Are**
==============

At Justworks, you'll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We're helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We're data-driven and never stop iterating. If you'd like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we'd love to hear from you.

We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you'll fit right in.

**Who You Are**

Reporting into the Senior Manager, Strategy Operations, you'll balance strategic thinking, program execution, and analytical rigor in equal measure. You'll own the execution and delivery of strategic initiatives—refining and maintaining the operating system, designing the operating rhythms and decision mechanisms that allow Operations to scale from foundational work into systems at scale.

You're energized by environments where parts of the organization are still stabilizing, others are being brought together under shared standards, and new operating capabilities must be built from scratch. You bring strong operational judgment and the ability to translate strategic direction into results. You're equally comfortable building a 90-day roadmap, driving a cross-functional initiative to completion, or diving into metrics to understand what's working and what's not.

In this role, success looks like building the systems and operating infrastructure that allow Operations to scale as a cohesive, well-run division by raising the bar on how our people work and supporting the identification and execution of our highest-leverage opportunities.

**Your Success Profile**

**What You Will Work On**

* **Partner with Operations Leadership** to identify the highest-impact opportunities to improve how Operations operates, with a focus on reducing customer and operational effort at scale.
* **Run the operating system**, including planning rhythms, execution cadences, reporting, and accountability mechanisms.
* **Build and maintain** AI-powered workflows that reduce the administrative layer of running the operating system, enabling the team to focus on higher-value work.
* **Lead and drive operations programs** **and initiatives** from definition through execution, while effectively partnering with Technology, Finance & Accounting, and Customer Success teams to coordinate dependencies, align on requirements, and resolve execution bottlenecks.
* **Leverage data** to identify trends and translate insights into actionable recommendations that inform strategy and decision-making across the function.
* **Create visibility and accountability** through reporting, dashboards, and progress tracking that keep stakeholders aligned on what's working and what needs adjustment.
* **Perform other related duties as assigned**. Be ready to own high-priority initiatives and workstreams that emerge as Operations' priorities shift.

**How You Will Do Your Work**

Success in this role is defined not only by what you deliver, but *how* you deliver it. Your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities, and personal attributes are anchored in the following:

* **Systems Thinking**: You see how the parts connect and are motivated to simplify complex operational and execution challenges. You understand trade-offs and design solutions that work across silos.
* **Strategic Mindset:** You anticipates future trends and implications accurately; articulates credible pictures and visions of possibilities that will create sustainable value.
* **Execution Focus**: You move with urgency and clarity. You drive initiatives to completion, make measurable progress every week, and adapt when plans change. You're comfortable saying "here's what done looks like" and holding the line.
* **Ownership & Accountability**: You take full responsibility for your work. You identify and remove blockers, escalate when needed, and don't wait for permission to improve things.
* **Influence Without Authority**: You build trust with peers and leaders across the organization. You coordinate complex efforts through relationship and clarity, not formal power.
* **Adaptability**: You stay steady in a changing environment. You learn quickly, find where you can add most value, and shift focus when priorities change. You're equally comfortable facilitating a meeting or diving into Jira to untangle a workflow.

title: Chief Program Officer

Today, Greenwich House offers a diverse range of programs in health, human services, education, and the arts, serving thousands of New Yorkers each year. Learn more at *www.greenwichhouse.org*.

**The Opportunity**

The Chief Program Officer (CPO) is a member of the executive leadership team and holds executive accountability for the overall performance, quality, financial sustainability, and strategic direction of all programs operated by Greenwich House and its two affiliates.

The CPO directly supervises and develops three vice presidents responsible for the organization's diverse program portfolios. The successful candidate will be a strategic and financially astute leader who develops strong leadership teams, promotes collaboration across programs and administrative functions, and balances high expectations with compassion, flexibility, and respect for the people who do this work.

The team operates through mutual trust, respect, transparency, and a shared commitment to the mission. Each executive brings distinct expertise and perspective to organizational decisions. title: SVP, Business Development
description:
**SVP, Business Development (NY, NY)**

Marquee Brands owns and manages a portfolio of global brands across consumer products and channels in Home & Culinary, Luxury, Fashion, and Sports & Active. Our team is committed to driving organic growth through natural brand extensions, impactful marketing and direct consumer engagement. Our promise is to keep our brands’ storied success going through relevant product and expanded distribution, geographic expansion, while staying true to each brand’s founding message and origin.

Marquee Brands is looking for a senior business development leader to contribute to and run the company’s new business strategy across its whole brand portfolio. Reporting to the Chief Business Development Officer, the SVP of Business Development will play a key role in executing the licensing growth agenda. They will lead a team of business development professionals, open and close transformational partnerships, and act as a senior face of Marquee Brands to licensees, retailers and industry partners around the world.

The SVP will find and prioritize the highest-value opportunities across brands, categories, channels and geographies, in line with each brand’s DNA and long-term strategy. They will work as a strategic partner to the executive team and to brand, marketing, legal and finance leaders. This person will turn portfolio strategy into a disciplined pipeline that produces revenue and will personally lead the most complex and important deals.

* 15+ years of progressive experience in brand licensing and new business development, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role (VP level or above).

* Experience building, leading and developing high-performing business development teams.

Willing to travel domestically and internationally

title: Director of Design
description:

With an annual budget of $2.3 billion and more than 7,000 employees throughout the five boroughs, the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (NYC DOHMH) is one of the largest public health agencies in the world, serving 8 million New Yorkers from diverse ethnic and cultural backgrounds. Investments and improvements through this initiative will help modernize DOHMH’s foundational capabilities and data infrastructure, enabling it to partner in complex health and health care environments and, in turn, support better public health outcomes, including COVID-19. This initiative supports larger efforts to rebalance investments in public health and more equitably serve communities and populations.

The selected candidate will be an employee of Public Health Solutions, a nonprofit organization which is the fiscal and administrative manager of the grant but will work be supervised by DOHMH. **This is a grant-funded position ending in November 2027.**

The Office of External Affairs manages many of the agency’s most critical interactions with the public, from raising awareness and promoting healthy behaviors to advancing policies and responding to health emergencies. The Bureau of Communications, housed within the Office of External Affairs, develops culturally responsive public health marketing campaigns; generates and crafts materials to inform New Yorkers of health information and program services, ensuring accessibility for all; provides access to translation services for collateral materials and clinics; maintains the agency’s website; and publishes content on the agency’s social media platforms. Within Creative Communications, the Design group oversees the artwork, design, layout, and creation of print and digital media to inform New Yorkers of key health topics and emergency situations.

DOHMH has an opening for a Director of Design. The Director of Design is responsible for the look and feel, creation, and development of program-specific and/or Health Department-wide creative projects, in collaboration with the larger Creative Communications team. The Director oversees the day-to-day operations of the Design team, workflow, and management of staff.

title: Director of Product, Mobile
description:
CLEAR is building THE secure identity company of the future. Our mission is to make experiences safer and easier—physically and digitally. With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it's at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.

We are looking for a visionary, customer-obsessed, and technology-focused product management leader with expertise in building and scaling consumer mobile experiences. * 10+ years of product management experience, with significant experience building and scaling consumer mobile products.

title: Vice President, Sales
description:
**Vice President, Sales**

**Location:** New York, NY or Beverly, MA (Hybrid)  
**Reports To:** President, Quarto US

**Lead the Future of Book Publishing Sales**
--------------------------------------------

Quarto is seeking a strategic, commercially driven **Vice President of Sales** to lead our North American sales organization and drive growth across all channels, customers, and publishing categories.

As a member of the Senior Leadership Team, the VP of Sales will shape and execute the company's sales strategy, oversee key customer relationships, and lead a high-performing team focused on revenue growth, profitability, and market expansion. This role is ideal for an experienced sales executive who combines deep industry knowledge with strong leadership, business acumen, and a passion for publishing.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Drive Revenue & Growth**

* Develop and execute sales strategies that deliver revenue, profitability, and market share objectives.
* Lead sales planning, forecasting, and performance management across all channels.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing business, acquire new customers, and grow market presence.
* Partner closely with Publishing teams to provide customer insights that inform acquisitions, product development, and publishing strategy.
* Drive growth across both frontlist and backlist publishing programs.

### **Lead Key Customer & Channel Relationships**

* Maintain executive-level relationships with major retailers, wholesalers, distributors, and strategic partners.
* Develop channel strategies across national accounts, independent bookstores, e-commerce, specialty retail, gift, museum, and emerging sales channels.
* Negotiate major agreements, promotional opportunities, and strategic partnerships.
* Lead customer planning and business reviews with key accounts.

### **Use Data to Drive Business Decisions**

* Lead annual sales planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes.
* Analyze sales trends, customer performance, inventory implications, and market opportunities.
* Monitor competitive activity and changing consumer behavior to inform strategic decisions.
* Leverage analytics and reporting tools to improve sales effectiveness and operational performance.

### **Build & Develop a High-Performing Team**

* Lead, coach, and inspire a talented sales organization.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Support talent development, succession planning, and recruitment efforts.
* Partner effectively across Publishing, Marketing, Operations, and Finance to achieve company objectives.

### **Contribute as a Senior Leader**

* Serve as a key member of Quarto's Senior Leadership Team.
* Help shape company strategy, priorities, and long-term growth initiatives.
* Represent Quarto at industry events, conferences, trade shows, and customer meetings.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Publishing, or a related field required.
* MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive sales leadership experience within publishing, media, consumer products, or a related industry.
* Significant experience managing national accounts and multi-channel sales organizations.
* Proven record of delivering revenue growth, profitability, and strategic business results.

### **Skills & Experience**

* Deep understanding of the North American book trade, retail landscape, wholesale distribution, and e-commerce channels.
* Strong financial acumen with experience in forecasting, budgeting, and profit management.
* Exceptional strategic planning, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Proven success leading and developing high-performing teams.
* Strong analytical capabilities and experience using data to inform business decisions.
* Knowledge of illustrated publishing and enthusiast publishing categories is a plus.

**Why Join Quarto?**
--------------------

This is a unique opportunity to lead sales for one of the world's foremost illustrated book publishers. You'll play a critical role in shaping the future growth of our business, influencing publishing strategy, strengthening key industry relationships, and helping bring exceptional books to readers around the world.

If you're a strategic leader who thrives on driving growth, building partnerships, and leading teams to success, we'd love to hear from you.

*QuartoUS is an equal opportunity employer; M/F/D/V are encouraged to apply. Full-time employees are eligible for our comprehensive benefits program. Our range of benefits include, but are not limited to, Medical insurance, Dental, Vision, Health Care/Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, Pre-Tax and Roth 401(k), Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance, Life/AD&D Insurance, Commuter Benefits & generous paid time off.*

***All applicants should be authorized to work in the United States. Quarto does not provide sponsorships.***

title: Brand Lead, TikTok Shop Ops
description:
At SuperOrdinary, we're the driving force behind the global success of today's most exciting consumer brands. More than an agency, we're the go-to growth partner for brands looking to win in social commerce, connecting industry leaders like Disney, H&M, Laneige, Touchland, Glow Recipe, and Peter Thomas Roth with creators and consumers around the world. Our team of e-commerce, creator, and social commerce experts helps brands build influence, accelerate sales, and create meaningful consumer connections across the world's fastest-growing marketplaces.

We're at the forefront of the social commerce revolution, pioneering growth on TikTok Shop and other emerging platforms where content, community, and commerce come together. The playbook is constantly evolving and so are we. We thrive in an environment where experimentation, speed, and continuous learning are essential to staying ahead.

We're looking for people who are naturally curious, solutions-oriented, and energized by solving complex challenges. The best teammates here have a hustle mentality, embrace change, and are always looking for better ways to build, test, and scale. We set a high bar for ourselves and for our partners, earning our reputation as the trusted experts brands rely on to navigate an ever-changing landscape and deliver exceptional results.

Role Overview  
  
The Brand Lead is the strategic and operational owner of a portfolio of brands within SuperOrdinary’s social commerce business. This role leads brand communication, growth strategy, and go-to-market execution, while managing and developing a high-performing team.  
As the primary, senior-facing point of contact for brand partners, the Brand Lead is accountable for overall performance, team execution, and operational excellence across all social commerce initiatives. This role may be leveled at the Manager, Senior Manager, or Director level based on experience and scope.  
  
Key Responsibilities  
  
Enterprise Client Communication

* Own enterprise-level brand partnerships as the main point of contact
* Set communication cadence, lead weekly/biweekly syncs
* Manage stakeholder expectations with clear, proactive, and confident communication

Growth Strategy & GTM Ownership

* Develop and execute multi-quarter TikTok Shop growth strategies spanning assortment, promotions, affiliates, livestreams, and paid media alignment
* Lead GTM planning for launches, tentpole moments, and major campaigns
* Continuously identify new growth opportunities and expansion levers

Performance Management & Optimization

* Monitor and optimize key KPIs across sales, traffic, and conversion
* Use data to inform decisions and refine strategy in real time

Executive Reporting & Insights

* Analyze sales performance, traffic, and conversion metrics to identify trends and growth drivers
* Deliver weekly and monthly reporting with clear insights, strategic recommendations, and action plans
* Present concise, executive-ready decks and verbal readouts that translate data into decisions

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Partner cross-functionally with internal teams (ads, live, ops, finance, leadership) to unblock issues and drive results

Team Leadership

* Lead, coach, and develop team members
* Set priorities, clarify ownership, and ensure high execution standards
* Build scalable processes that reduce management overhead and enable team efficiency

Market & Platform Expertise

* Stay ahead of TikTok Shop trends, algorithm updates, and emerging best practices
* Apply platform insights to inform strategy, experimentation, and optimization

Qualifications

* Experience: 3+ years of experience in e-commerce, social commerce, or brand management, with hands-on exposure to platforms such as TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify/DTC, Walmart Marketplace, or similar. Direct TikTok Shop experience is a strong plus.
* Background: Platform, brand or agency background preferred, with experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder client relationships.
* Client Communication: Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with a proven track record of delivering C-suite–ready decks, insights, and recommendations.
* Affiliate & Creator Experience: Experience with affiliate marketing, creator partnerships, and influencer ecosystems is a strong advantage.
* Leadership & Program Management: Strong program and team leadership capabilities, able to own end-to-end initiatives across multiple brands, workstreams, and timelines.
* Analytical Rigor: Highly data-driven, with experience in forecasting, KPI diagnosis, performance analysis, and translating insights into clear action plans.
* Organization & Execution: Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple brands and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Ownership & Mindset: Operates with urgency, accountability, and a solutions-oriented mindset; comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving results.
* Adaptability: Thrives in fast-moving environments, solves problems creatively, and adapts quickly to platform, market, and business changes.

* What We Offer
* Career Growth: Join a rapidly growing global social commerce business as we expand our presence in New York City. Be part of an exciting opportunity to help establish and grow our Manhattan-based team, with significant potential for career advancement and professional development.
* Competitive Compensation: Earn a competitive $90,000–$110,000 base salary (depending on experience and skill set), plus eligibility for a performance-based annual bonus.

* NYC Office Expansion & Hybrid Flexibility: We're actively working toward establishing a dedicated office space in Manhattan, NYC. As we build our New York presence, we're looking for team members who are excited to collaborate in person and help shape our growing East Coast operations. Our anticipated schedule is 4 days onsite and 1 remote day per week, once our Manhattan office is established.
* Team Culture & Perks: Join a collaborative, entrepreneurial team that values creativity, innovation, and connection. As we establish our NYC office, we look forward to introducing team experiences and workplace perks that reflect our company culture.

title: Chief of Staff to the CTO
description:
Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing.

**The Opportunity at Altana**

*This role is a force multiplier for the CTO and the Product, Engineering, and Implementation leadership team. You operate as an extension of the CTO, absorbing context across every workstream, making real prioritization calls, wielding real authority, and running the operating system of a technical org that ships to both commercial and government customers around the world.*

*Beyond execution, you hold the business of the Product/Eng org: its operating cadence, its budget, and its people planning, in partnership with Finance and the People team.* *You also build and lead the org's Program Management Office: a team of technical program managers who run the portfolio of cross-functional programs and customer deliveries.*

*This is a position of operational ownership and trusted judgment; ensuring the technical functions are aligned with Altana's business strategy and corporate governance. Where the role touches comp, leveling, org design, and budget, you apply the frameworks the People CoE and Finance own. You are the CTO's embedded counterpart to those functions, not a parallel authority.*

**You Will**

*In this role, you will own:*

* **Strategic projects.** Lead or staff high-priority critical organizational initiatives identified by EPD leadership.
* **Operating cadence.** Staff meetings, roadmap planning and portfolio reviews, metrics reviews, and leadership offsites — set agendas, drive follow-through, document and distribute decisions.
* **PMO leadership.** Build and lead a team of technical program managers. Hire, develop, and set the bar for the function, and decide where TPMs are embedded versus centrally deployed.
* **Portfolio and delivery.** Own the portfolio view of in-flight programs and customer deliveries, intake and prioritization, and delivery standards (planning, status, risk and dependency tracking, launch readiness, government contract reporting), plus the tooling that makes delivery health visible.
* **Cross-functional integration.** Across the various sub-teams within Product, Engineering, Implementation and our public and private sector delivery motions — surface where priorities collide and force resolution.
* **Decision and information flow.** What reaches the CTO, in what form, and what gets escalated versus resolved below.
* **Executive communications.** Board and all-hands material and internal updates for the Product/Eng org, grounded in its real state.
* **People partnership.** With the People CoE, run headcount planning, org design, and leveling/comp inside Product/Eng — applying central frameworks, owning the org's read on where it's over- or under-built, and serving as the CTO's single counterpart to the People team.
* **Finance partnership.** Own the Product/Eng budget and spend against the plan Finance sets — track burn, flag variance, model headcount and vendor trade-offs, and act as the CTO's counterpart to FP&A. Own the success metrics in partnership with FP&A to ensure tight alignment on business levers to drive growth and deployment of capital.

**You Have**

* ~10 years in product management, technical program or portfolio management, strategy, business operations, or a role with genuine operational ownership — not coordination.
* A record of holding multiple parallel workstreams, competing stakeholders, and ambiguous ownership, and keeping all of it moving.
* Experience building or running a PMO or program portfolio. You've designed intake, prioritization, and delivery-tracking processes that teams use rather than work around.
* Experience managing and growing a team, ideally program or project managers. You've hired, coached, and given hard feedback, and built a function others want to join.
* Enough technical fluency to hold a real conversation with a platform engineer — APIs, infrastructure, deployment, architecture at a conceptual level — and to read a design doc and push on it. Not a coder.
* Financial and operational fluency: managing a budget, speaking to variance, tackling headcount and spend trade-offs.
* Comfort with org design and workforce planning as a partner to a People function — fluent enough to be a real thought partner, without running it.
* Influence beyond your own team: moving engineers, PMs, and GTM leads through trust, framing, and timing, not by invoking the CTO's name.
* Extreme organizational precision — systems legible to others, clean first drafts, async updates that need minimal editing.
* Nice-to-have: experience delivering programs under government contracts (milestones, deliverables, compliance reporting.

**Nice to have, but not required**

* Experience building production systems with LLMs, agents, evals, or retrieval.
* Experience using engineering metrics such as DORA or SPACE to improve how a team works.
* Background in trade, supply chain, compliance, or working with government customers.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Our client runs the compliant system of record you build on to move, store, and grow money. Launch financial products your customers love. We provide the financial primitives, licenses, and compliance, and our forward deployed team gets you live in two weeks. Under the hood, fiat and blockchain run as one system. Their customers never see any of it. Money comes in, money goes out, and it just gets there.

**The Role**

Our customers don't just call our APIs. They build their products on us. Their balances, their payment operations, their compliance state. Which means our business succeeds exactly as far as theirs do. Forward Deployed Engineering is the team that makes that true, one customer at a time.

You'll report to our CTO and embed with one strategic customer at a time, the enterprises building their products where we're investing deepest. You'll understand their business, their constraints, and their pain points better than anyone, and then you'll build what their launch needs.

Here's a concrete example. A global payouts customer is expanding into a new market where we don't yet have local account infrastructure. You scope the requirements with their engineering team, then build the virtual account infrastructure, in our core codebase, that their launch depends on. When it ships, it's not a one-off. It becomes a core product that we sell to the next ten customers.

That's the defining property of this role. This is not a services role, and it's not technical support. You're a product engineer whose roadmap comes from a live customer instead of a planning doc. Everything you build lands in the core platform, and the best of it becomes product the whole company resells. Engagements are scoped at contract time. You're delivering what we've committed to, not absorbing unbounded requests. But within that scope, the what, the why, and the how are yours to figure out with the customer.

**What You'll Do**

* **Deploy into customer contexts.** Iterate daily with your customer's engineering and operations teams, mostly over Zoom and Slack, with some travel to spend real time on site.
* **Scope the build with the customer.** You're not handed a spec. You work out what to build and why with the customer directly, paired with a deployment strategist who owns the commercial side.
* **Build across the full stack.** TypeScript and React, NestJS with Postgres and Prisma, and AWS (SQS, SNS, Lambda). New account infrastructure, blockchain integrations, API endpoints, compliance workflows, whatever the launch requires.
* **Generalize the bespoke.** Identify patterns across implementations and work with product to turn engagement output into first-class platform features.
* **Prototype fast, ship carefully.** Rapid iteration against live customer workflows, accepting some throwaway work and making sure what isn't throwaway gets productized properly, all while debugging production issues in real time, sometimes with the customer watching.
* **Design for correctness and auditability.** This is money-movement infrastructure. Edge cases have real consequences, and you think about failure modes before they happen.
* **Communicate crisply** with customer engineers, operators, founders, and finance leaders, and with our own product leads, whose pods your work must generalize into.

**Who You Are**

* **You're a builder first.** We're flexible on tenure. We'll hire a scrappy engineer straight out of school or a seasoned customer-facing engineer. We're not flexible on the bar. You ship production-grade, full-stack work, and you have something you've built to prove it.
* **You're AI-native.** Agentic tools are how you already build, and we'll ask you to show us.
* **You're energized by customers, not shielded from them.** You're comfortable operating directly with an enterprise engineering team, under ambiguity, where the requirements are yours to discover.
* **You're obsessed with correctness and resilience.** You love a good state machine. You think carefully about what happens when things go wrong, because with money they can't.
* **Strong pluses.** Payments and fintech infrastructure experience, blockchain and stablecoin integration work, and a forward-deployed or solutions architect background where you *built* rather than just configured.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Your customer launches on time, on our rails, and their volume ramps because what you built works.
* The infrastructure you shipped for one customer is now core product being sold to the next ten.
* Your customer's engineering team treats you as one of their own, and our team trusts what you merge.
* You've defined, alongside our CTO, what "forward deployed" means.
* You're an early member of a function we're building the company around.

**How We Work**

We run on three principles:

* **2% better, every day.** One percent for yourself, one percent for the people around you.
* **Telos.** From the Greek word telos, meaning not just done but fulfilled. Everyone here is focused on one mission and knows each other's Telos.
* **Build.** Embody the builder's mindset. Make things, solve problems, and have fun doing it.

title: Founding GTM
description:
#### **About GoodRec**

GoodRec makes it easy to play sports. Every week, more than **20,000 people** use GoodRec to play sports and meet people in person. We organized over **65,000 games in 2025** and are on track for more in 2026.

We’re building the platform for recreational sports — starting with pickup games and expanding into every way you play.

#### **About the Role**

We’re looking for an ambitious, entrepreneurial GTM to accelerate growth at Goodrec.You’ll work directly with the CEO on some of the company’s highest-priority growth problems.

One month you might launch a new growth channel. The next you might develop a strategic partnership, help crack a market, or test an entirely new business line.

Your job is simple: **find opportunities to grow GoodRec, prove they work, and turn them into scalable playbooks.**

#### **What You’ll Do**

* Launch and scale new growth initiatives
* Identify and test new business lines
* Develop strategic partnerships
* Test new acquisition and distribution channels
* Research markets, competitors, and growth opportunities
* Analyze customer and business data to find opportunities
* Talk directly with customers and partners
* Take ideas from **hypothesis test results scalable process**
* Build systems and processes where none exist today
* Work directly with the CEO and leadership team on company priorities

This isn’t a traditional sales role, and it isn’t a traditional strategy role. You’ll be expected to **figure out what will move the business forward and then make it happen.**

#### **Who We’re Looking For**

You have roughly **2–3 years of professional experience** and a track record of being excellent at what you do.

You:

* Are extremely smart, curious, and resourceful
* Have grit and can will things into existence
* Move quickly without needing much structure
* Think analytically but love execution
* Take ownership instead of waiting for direction
* Are comfortable selling, analyzing data, and building a process in the same day
* Communicate clearly and confidently
* Have high standards and care about details
* Want significantly more responsibility than most roles give someone early in their career
* Are excited by startups and building things from scratch

Experience in startups, consulting, growth, operations, business development, finance, or similar environments is helpful, but **we care much more about ability, trajectory, and evidence that you can get things done.**

#### **Why GoodRec**

* **Real ownership.** You’ll own projects that directly affect company growth.
* **Work directly with the CEO.** You’ll be involved in some of the most important problems and decisions in the company.
* **Build, don’t maintain.** You’ll constantly launch, test, and create things that don’t exist yet.
* **Meaningful scale.** We already connect 20,000+ people every week, but we believe GoodRec can become dramatically larger.
* **Grow with the company.** If you prove you can build and scale something, you’ll have the opportunity to own increasingly large parts of the business.

If you want a highly structured job with narrowly defined responsibilities, this probably isn’t the right role.

If you want to **build, move fast, and help create the future of recreational sports**, we’d love to meet you.

#### **Compensation**

The budgeted base salary range for this role is $70,000–$100,000. Base salary may vary depending on experience, skills and business needs. In addition to base pay, GoodRec offers healthcare benefits and paid time off.

title: Partnerships Lead, New Verticals
description:
**About Figure**

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure's on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure's ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.  
  
Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings from S&P and Moody's on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.  
  
We're proud to be recognized as one of Forbes' Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC's World's Top Fintech Companies.

**About the Role**

You will scale three New Verticals: depository institutions, home improvement, and small business lending.

This role grows the volume of loans originated on Figure's platform. We want lenders, platforms, and depository institutions to originate on Figure's loan origination system, through private-label programs, embedded and SaaS-style integrations, and direct adoption. You take these partnerships from first conversation through launch and scaling: structuring the commercial terms, negotiating, and pulling together the internal teams needed to launch.

You will report to the Director of Platform Partnerships and primarily own the hard middle of the process, where partnerships are actually won or lost.

Work across Figure's key growth markets (including small business, home improvement, and depository institutions) to bring partners onto the platform via direct relationships, private-label programs, embedded integrations, and key channel ecosystem partnerships.

**What You'll Do**

* Map the market and source high-value strategic, product, and channel partnerships.
* Structure and negotiate the commercial terms and product setup for each partner.
* Build our new bank and credit union channel, landing the partners and integrations that make Figure easy for these institutions to adopt.
* Win partnerships in the home improvement and small business lending ecosystems that drive funded volume across multiple products (e.g. HELOC, fix-&-flip, DSCR).
* Coordinate the internal teams a launch depends on, including product, engineering, credit, legal, and implementation, to get partners live and scaling.
* Own each partnership internally. Spot where it is likely to stall and clear the path before it does.
* Build repeatable program structures and playbooks so each new partnership moves faster than the last.
* Track your deal pipeline and activity in Salesforce (our CRM).

**What We Look For**

Experience with lending, fintech, SaaS, or financial institutions is a plus.

* A working understanding of consumer and small-business lending. You do not need deep capital-markets expertise for this role, but you should understand how originations work.
* Organized and detail-oriented, and good at getting cross-functional teams to move.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and able to own outcomes.

* Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

* Base Compensation Range: $120,000 - $150,000/yr
* Total Compensation Range: $190,000 - $240,000/yr

Position Summary
  
About us We are seeking an experienced public works and capital-project leader to direct its Engineering and Transportation Divisions. The position is part of the Department of Public Works and offers substantial professional independence under the general supervision of the Superintendent of Public Works. Our company values diverse perspectives and encourages qualified candidates from varied professional and personal backgrounds to apply. It also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees in accordance with applicable disability and human-rights requirements.
  
Position Summary The Director of Engineering and Transportation is a senior managerial position responsible for planning, supervising, and directing public works, engineering, transportation, and capital-improvement activities for the company. The Director leads the Engineering and Transportation Divisions through the complete project lifecycle, including planning, design, consultant selection, budget development, grant coordination, construction administration, financial recovery, closeout, and long-term infrastructure planning. The position also supervises engineering staff, establishes departmental priorities, manages consultant relationships, represents the company before boards and public agencies, and ensures compliance with applicable laws, codes, funding requirements, and professional standards. A principal responsibility will be stabilizing and developing a relatively new engineering department. The selected leader must guide less-experienced employees, establish clear priorities, and ensure that staff focus on the company's operational and capital needs rather than individual project preferences. The Director will also work closely with the Grant Administrator and departments such as Planning and Finance to support grant applications, permitting, eligibility compliance, reimbursement submissions, and recovery of eligible project costs.
  
Appointment and Civil Service Requirements This role is in the competitive jurisdictional class and will initially be filled through a provisional appointment if no applicable eligible list is currently available. To obtain a permanent appointment, the selected candidate must: Complete the applicable New York State civil service examination when scheduled. Achieve a sufficiently high score to become reachable for permanent appointment. Generally rank among the three highest-scoring eligible candidates available for appointment. There is no residency requirement for this position.
  
Key Responsibilities Engineering and Transportation Leadership Plan, assign, supervise, review, and direct engineering and transportation activities. Lead the Engineering and Transportation Divisions within the Department of Public Works. Establish departmental work programs, priorities, timelines, and performance expectations. Supervise, coach, develop, and evaluate subordinate engineering staff. Provide consistent leadership to a developing team with varying levels of experience. Align departmental activity with citywide priorities and public-service objectives. Promote accountability, collaboration, sound judgment, and professional development. Coordinate engineering and transportation work with other departments and external stakeholders. Capital Improvement Program Management Develop and manage significant portions of the company's capital-improvement program. Direct small- and large-scale public works projects from planning through final closeout. Establish project scope, objectives, schedules, budgets, milestones, and deliverables. Guide project development through design, bidding, construction, administration, inspection, and completion. Monitor project progress, expenditures, risks, and contractual obligations. Resolve technical, financial, regulatory, and operational issues. Ensure capital projects meet the company standards, public needs, and funding requirements. Provide leadership across multiple concurrent projects. Capital Budgets and Financial Oversight Oversee capital-project budgets, expenditures, financial controls, and fund recovery. Monitor available funding and project costs throughout the capital lifecycle. Coordinate financial reporting and reimbursement documentation. Work with the Controller's and Chamberlain's Offices to gather, reconcile, and process financial information. Identify eligible project costs and support timely reimbursement submissions. title: Pizza Purchasing Analyst
description:
Job Summary

Slice City Pizza is seeking an analytical and detail-oriented Pizza Purchasing Analyst to evaluate purchasing data, monitor ingredient costs, and support strategic procurement decisions. The successful candidate will analyze spending patterns, compare supplier pricing, assess purchasing trends, and help ensure that ingredients, packaging materials, and restaurant supplies are obtained efficiently and cost-effectively. This role requires strong analytical abilities, attention to detail, and effective collaboration with procurement, inventory, kitchen, and management teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Analyze purchasing data for pizza ingredients, including flour, dough, cheese, tomatoes, sauces, meats, vegetables, and seasonings.
* Review purchasing trends, supplier prices, order volumes, and spending patterns to identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Compare supplier quotations, product quality, delivery terms, and pricing structures.
* Monitor price fluctuations and evaluate their potential impact on food costs and operating budgets.
* Analyze historical usage, sales patterns, and inventory data to support purchasing forecasts.
* Prepare purchasing reports, cost comparisons, and performance summaries for management.
* Coordinate with procurement personnel to review purchase orders and identify unusual spending.
* Evaluate supplier performance using pricing, product quality, order accuracy, and delivery reliability.
* Identify opportunities to reduce waste, improve order quantities, and avoid unnecessary purchases.
* Work with inventory staff to investigate stock discrepancies and purchasing variances.
* Help establish purchasing benchmarks and track performance against approved budgets.
* Maintain accurate records of supplier quotations, pricing histories, purchasing data, and analytical findings.
* Support negotiations by providing data-driven recommendations on supplier pricing and purchasing volumes.
* Monitor the availability and cost of packaging materials, beverages, cleaning products, and other restaurant supplies.
* Recommend improvements to purchasing procedures, reporting methods, and procurement efficiency.

Qualifications and Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in business analytics, finance, supply chain management, accounting, economics, or a related field preferred.
* Previous experience in purchasing analysis, procurement, inventory management, or financial reporting is an advantage.
* Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in spreadsheets, including formulas, sorting, filtering, and data analysis.
* Familiarity with purchasing systems, inventory software, or reporting tools.
* Ability to interpret cost trends and communicate findings clearly.
* Strong attention to detail and recordkeeping abilities.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet reporting deadlines.
* Understanding of food costs, supplier pricing, and inventory practices is beneficial.

Preferred Skills

* Purchasing data analysis and cost reporting.
* Supplier price comparison and performance evaluation.
* Budget monitoring and spending analysis.
* Demand forecasting and purchasing trend analysis.
* Inventory reconciliation and waste reduction.
* Spreadsheet reporting and data visualization.
* Strategic sourcing support and cost optimization.
* Critical thinking and data-driven decision-making.

Work Environment

The Pizza Purchasing Analyst works primarily in an administrative or restaurant operations setting, collaborating with procurement personnel, inventory staff, suppliers, and management. The role involves reviewing data, preparing reports, tracking supplier costs, and occasionally coordinating with receiving or kitchen teams to understand purchasing requirements. The position requires accuracy, organization, and the ability to manage deadlines.

* Competitive compensation.

* Professional training and development opportunities.
* Scheduling arrangements based on operational needs.
* Opportunities for advancement into procurement management, supply chain analysis, or purchasing leadership.

Slice City Pizza is the company named for this opportunity. Applicants should consult the employer's official information for verified details about its operations, locations, workplace policies, and available benefits.

Interested candidates should submit a resume highlighting relevant experience in purchasing analysis, procurement, business analytics, inventory control, or cost reporting. From Brooklyn to London, Medellin to Hong Kong, we have guided hundreds of clients in transforming real estate and economic development concepts, and public infrastructure, first into actionable plans and then into job-producing, community-strengthening assets.

Our clients include real estate owners and investors, hospitals and universities, cultural institutions and philanthropies, community development organizations, and governments.

HR&A has offices in Atlanta, Dallas, Los Angeles, New York, Raleigh, and Washington D.C. We come from diverse backgrounds, have a breadth of lived experience, and share a passion for cities. We are former city officials, executive directors, planners, lawyers, architects, and economists.

Hear more about the HR&A experience from our staff.

Learn more about careers at HR&A on our website here.

**THE PRACTICE** | HR&A’s Inclusive Cities practice leverages our deep understanding of government, knowledge of local and private economic forces, and analytical rigor to promote social and economic justice.

Our practice area centers racial equity and economic justice in economic development, policy, and planning. We help our clients identify who will benefit from economic development initiatives and show them how to design and execute more equitable projects, neighborhoods, and cities. By engaging communities and grassroots organizations in meaningful, non-extractive ways, we build new trust and durable partnerships. We launch new programs and community-driven projects to increase awareness and participation in our civic discourse, which is essential to shifting traditional economic development paradigms. Our team emboldens visionary public servants with the tools they need to embed equity into their policy and practice. We serve as a bridge between ideas and implementation, truly changing systems from workforce development to criminal legal system reform, so that lives are changed for the better.

We have an exciting opening for a Senior Data Analyst within the Ronald O. Perelman Department of Emergency Medicine, Research Division. In this role, the successful candidate will work under the direction of Principal Investigator and Medical Director for Geriatric Emergency Medicine, Dr. Ula Hwang. The Senior Data Analyst will be responsible for supporting data management and analyses using clinical, administrative, and operational data, and for planning, designing, and implementing statistical analyses. This will include working with large national and multicenter research network databases, including electronic health record (EHR) and claims data. The individual in this position will support multiple projects in day-to-day activities, including preliminary data analysis, data visualization, predictive and machine learning analytics, causal inference analyses, and results dissemination. All research and programming code must be regularly documented and archived per best practices. Other responsibilities will include coordinating and participating in regular meetings that pertain to data preparation, management, analyses and ongoing research projects. The analyst will communicate information and data in written and verbal form to colleagues as well as project and senior management teams. A successful applicant will be a strong communicator, be curious, inquisitive and resourceful, have a high degree of professional maturity and commitment to excellence, and be able to work autonomously and comfortably on a health services research team in an academic medical center environment.

**Job Responsibilities:**

Demonstrates knowledge of the organizations Core Values and incorporates them into the performance of duties.  
Maintains, cleans, and constructs analytic datasets and research cohorts from electronic health record (EHR) databases and other sources in support of research protocols and projects. Ensures that data are compiled, analyzed, and presented appropriately, and performs reviews to ensure data accuracy and completeness.  
Ensures compliance with HIPAA, IRB protocols, and data use agreements.  
Leads knowledge sharing and training of research staff in data extraction, data preparation, data standardization approaches using SQL, Epic Clarity and Caboodle databases, common data models including OMOP, PCORnet, data platforms such as Databricks, and NIA LINKAGE CMS Medicare/Medicaid claims data.  
Oversees and manages multicenter research data infrastructure both locally and nationally.

Performs coding, debugging and other tasks in support of data analyses.  
Troubleshoots data or software problems and rapidly resolves issues that occur.  
Under the supervision of research faculty, analyzes, develops, and interprets scientific results. Maintains clear documentation of analyses, including well-documented, version-controlled and reproducible code and analytic workflows. Presents findings to the research team and collaborators.  
Supports the development of publications and conference presentations, including drafting academic and non-academic publications and creating tables, figures, and other data visualizations for presentations.  
May perform other duties as assigned.

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**  
To qualify you must have a Bachelors Degree and 3-5 years of experience required.

**Preferred Qualifications:**  
Masters degree in a scientific discipline such as statistics, biostatistics, epidemiology, data science, or health economics, and at least 3-5 years of experience in a relevant setting, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.  
Strong quantitative skills and advanced programming skills in R, Python, SAS, and/or Stata.  
Experience working with EHR clinical data and/or CMS Medicare/Medicaid claims data.  
Ability to select and apply appropriate statistical methods for collecting, summarizing, and analyzing EHR and other large datasets.  
Excellent organizational, time management, and communication skills.  
Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative research team.  
Knowledge of principles and methods of biostatistics and epidemiology, including study design, statistical analysis, and causal inference.  
Experience with database queries and SQL, version control systems (e.g., Git/Github), and familiarity with healthcare coding systems and standards (e.g., ICD-10, CPT, NDC)  
Abitity to function independently, demonstrate strong analytical judgment, are inquisitive, anticipatory, resourceful, enjoy critical thinking, and are able to explain methodological choices

The Procurement Intelligence Analyst develops and delivers the analytics, market intelligence, performance reporting, and data insights that enable Enterprise Procurement to make informed, data-driven decisions. The role transforms procurement, supplier, financial, and operational data into actionable insights supporting category strategy, sourcing, Vendor Management, value realization, risk governance, and executive decision-making. Working collaboratively with Category Management, Vendor Management, Procurement Operations Hub, Finance, the Procurement Center of Excellence (COE), and business stakeholders, the role establishes trusted procurement reporting, spend visibility, supplier and vendor performance analytics, savings measurement, and market intelligence. The Procurement Intelligence Analyst also partners with the Procurement Digital Transformation Lead to advance automated reporting, AI-enabled analytics, and predictive insights as the organization builds a more digitally enabled procurement operating model.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

**Procurement Analytics, Performance & Executive Reporting**

* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve enterprise procurement dashboards, performance reports, and executive reporting that provide visibility into procurement value, operational performance, supplier performance, and strategic priorities.
* Establish and monitor procurement KPIs including savings and value realization, spend coverage, contract compliance, supplier performance, sourcing activity, cycle times, process efficiency, and stakeholder experience.
* Translate complex procurement data into clear insights, trends, and recommendations that support Procurement Leadership Team and executive decision-making.
* Produce recurring and ad hoc reporting for procurement leadership, governance forums, category reviews, Vendor Management reviews, and enterprise stakeholders.
* Ensure procurement reporting is accurate, timely, consistent, and supported by clearly defined metrics and trusted data sources.

**Spend, Category & Market Intelligence**

* Analyze enterprise spend across categories, suppliers, business units, and service areas to identify sourcing opportunities, demand trends, supplier concentration, and cost optimization opportunities.
* Develop category and supplier intelligence that supports category strategies, sourcing pipelines, negotiations, demand planning, and total cost of ownership analyses.
* Conduct market research and benchmarking across supplier markets, pricing trends, economic indicators, industry developments, and emerging technologies.
* Partner with Category Management to provide fact-based analytical support for category planning, supplier landscape assessments, business cases, and commercial recommendations.
* Maintain enterprise spend visibility and continuously improve spend classification, segmentation, and analytical usability.

**Supplier & Vendor Performance Intelligence**

* Develop and maintain supplier and vendor performance reporting, scorecards, and analytical views in support of Vendor Management and Category Management.
* Aggregate and analyze SLA, KPI, risk, issue, financial, and operational performance data to identify performance trends, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Provide analytical support for QBRs, executive business reviews, vendor governance meetings, supplier segmentation, and strategic account planning.
* Partner with Vendor Leads and business stakeholders to improve scorecard consistency, performance transparency, and actionable supplier insights.
* Support development of automated scorecards, alerts, dashboards, and reporting capabilities in partnership with the Procurement Digital Transformation Lead.

**Savings, Value Realization & Financial Insights**

* Develop and maintain enterprise methodologies, reporting, and controls for procurement savings, cost avoidance, and value realization.
* Track sourcing and category initiatives against approved value targets and provide transparent reporting on pipeline, realized value, and performance to plan.
* Partner with Finance and Category Management to validate savings methodologies, assumptions, baselines, and realized financial outcomes.
* Analyze procurement performance against annual targets and identify risks, gaps, and opportunities requiring leadership attention.
* Develop financial models, supplier comparisons, scenario analyses, and commercial evaluations supporting sourcing and procurement decisions.

**Data Governance, Digital Analytics & AI Enablement**

* Establish and maintain procurement data definitions, reporting standards, quality controls, and governance practices that improve consistency and trust in procurement information.
* Partner with Information Technology, Finance, Procurement Operations Hub, and system owners to improve procurement data architecture, source-system integration, and reporting reliability.
* Partner with the Procurement Digital Transformation Lead to automate procurement reporting, develop AI-enabled insights, and expand predictive and self-service analytics capabilities.
* Support analytics and reporting requirements for digital procurement, Vendor Management, Source-to-Pay automation, and digital workforce initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging analytics technologies, data visualization methods, and AI capabilities that improve procurement intelligence and decision support.

**Business Partnership & Continuous Improvement**

* Serve as the analytical partner to Category Management, Vendor Management, Procurement Operations Hub, Procurement COE, Finance, and business stakeholders requiring procurement intelligence.
* Provide data-driven recommendations that improve procurement performance, supplier outcomes, operational efficiency, governance, and stakeholder experience.

* Benchmark procurement performance and analytics maturity against relevant industry practices and recommend capability improvements.
* Promote a culture of data-driven decision-making, analytical discipline, and continuous improvement across the Procurement organization.

* Minimum 3-5 years of experience in procurement analytics, business intelligence, finance, data analysis, strategic sourcing, or a related analytical discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Python, or comparable analytics and data visualization tools.

**About ASCAP**

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. As a Senior Business Analyst, you will own the requirements for every application our Application Development team builds, from internal tools to customer-facing web applications. You will embed with our operations, finance, sales, and other business teams to understand how work really gets done, then turn what you learn into clear requirements, process flows, and specifications that our full-stack developers can build from. AI is central to how you will work: you will use AI tools to synthesize discovery, draft requirements and process flows, build quick prototypes, and write structured specifications that both developers and AI coding agents can work from.   + Run discovery sessions, workshops, and interviews with business users and stakeholders to document current processes, surface pain points, and define future-state solutions.

  + Are skilled in process modeling using BPMN or similar notation, with tools such as Lucidchart, Visio, or Miro.

  + Have working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, XML, and SQL, and can read API documentation, trace a data flow, and hold a technical conversation with developers.

  + Have experience defining non-functional requirements, including security, performance, and data privacy.

  + Have experience mentoring or guiding other analysts.

  + Have experience designing applications that integrate with ERP systems, including NetSuite.

  + Are familiar with integration middleware and enterprise integration platforms.

  + Are team players, able to effectively interact with staff at all levels of the organization.

  + Have strong conceptual, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  + Take ownership of outcomes, following open questions through to resolution.

**What's in it For You:**

  

* The opportunity to shape every application our team builds and to define how AI changes the way we deliver software.
* A supportive, diverse and global team with a growth mindset.
* A scaling company with great industry professionals.
* Amazing opportunities to get involved with exciting projects at significant scale with some of the leading global companies.

Founded in 2001, by two visionary traders, PCS Wireless, affectionately known as “PCS”, is not your average mobile distributor. Led by fearless entrepreneurs, PCS has completely transformed the landscape of the device resell market, both from a business and a consumer perspective.

**Job Description**
-------------------

ABOUT THE CAMPAIGN FINANCE BOARD
  
  
The Campaign Finance Board is a nonpartisan, independent city agency that empowers New Yorkers to have a greater impact on their elections. Our mission is to make local democracy more open, transparent, and equitable by removing barriers to participation.
  
  
We make it easier for New Yorkers to vote, meaningfully support candidates for city office, and run for office themselves. NYC Votes, our voter engagement initiative, meets people where they are to share trustworthy election information and help New Yorkers make a plan to vote. We publish the citywide Voter Guide, which delivers information about candidates directly to voters’ doors. Our public matching funds program ensures small contributions can make a big difference, allowing regular people to run for office by relying on the support of other regular people, not just wealthy donors and special interests. And we lift the veil on how candidates raise and spend money, increasing transparency and accountability in local government.
  
  
We believe that when every New Yorker is empowered to participate meaningfully in elections, candidates will better reflect the communities they serve, elected leaders will be more accountable to the public, and New Yorkers will have a democracy they can truly trust.
  
  
ABOUT THE UNIT
  
  
The People and Engagement Division is responsible for the agency's systems, policies, and resources that work to shape engagement and the employee experience at the CFB.
  
  
The division encompasses multiple units including the Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) unit, People and Culture unit, the Learning and Development unit, and the Labor Relations, Timekeeping, Payroll, Benefits and Compliance unit. Its work spans the entire employee lifecycle; from recruitment and selection, onboarding, to workplace culture, succession planning, learning and development, and organizational restructuring. The Division also manages employee and labor relations, payroll, timekeeping, offboarding, and benefits administration. Together we work to build people systems that allow for a positive employee experience and workplace culture.
  
  
The People & Culture Unit serves as an internal strategic partner dedicated to supporting employees and advancing the agency across every stage of the employee lifecycle. The unit delivers comprehensive HR-based solutions in the areas of talent operations, employee growth and development, and organizational culture. Its work begins with recruitment and selection and extends through onboarding, employee engagement, career development, workplace culture, and more. The team is committed to fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing work environment where employees can thrive and grow professionally. Through data-informed practices and people-centered strategies, the unit helps strengthen the CFB while ensuring alignment with the CFB's goals, values, and overall mission. By balancing operational excellence with employee support, the People & Culture Unit Department plays a critical role in building a resilient, engaged, and future-focused workforce.
  
  
JOB DESCRIPTION
  
  
The Talent Operations Specialist reports to the Talent Operation Manager. This role will support the full recruitment lifecycle at the CFB, from workforce planning and sourcing through selection and hiring serving as one of the agency's talent acquisition experts within the People & Culture department.
  
  
The role develops and executes sourcing strategies to build diverse, qualified talent pipelines, partners closely with hiring managers on recruitment plans and hiring packets, and manages day-to-day operations including job postings, screening, interviews, and offer coordination. It also uses recruitment data and analytics to improve hiring efficiency and inform workforce planning, while integrating principles around fairness, equity, and inclusion, ensuring compliance with NYC civil service requirements, and the NYC EEO Policy throughout the process.
  
  
Beyond individual searches, the specialist acts as a strategic advisor to hiring managers, delivering high-quality service to candidates and stakeholders while keeping vacancies moving within established timelines.
  
  
By helping to build the team that carries out the agency's work, this role directly strengthens the CFB's ability to safeguard fair, transparent elections for all New Yorkers.
  
  
The responsibilities and tasks to be completed in this role include, but are not limited to:  
  
  
  
Proactive Sourcing & Talent Pipeline Development
  
  

* Maintain relationships with external recruitment vendors to ensure effective sourcing for current vacancies and pipeline roles, partnering closely with vendors on hard-to-fill positions.

  
- Execute sourcing strategies to build strong, diverse talent pipelines using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search queries, high-traffic and reputable job boards, professional associations, and other - talent databases.
  
  

* Build and nurture a passive candidate pipeline for recurring and high-volume roles within the agency.

  

* Building diverse pipelines through partnerships with colleges, professional associations, and community-based organizations (not just databases/LinkedIn).

Everyone on our team has a part to play

As a Sports Trader, you'll start by learning the core skills that power our odds and markets. You'll receive hands-on training in how sports betting works, how we use models and data to manage prices, and how we monitor news and customer behavior to keep our pricing sharp.

Your day-to-day will include:

* Learning to set and manage prices on basketball games, player stats, and futures markets — from pre-game to live in-play odds — using our in-house tools and models.
* Monitoring real-time news, stats, and industry pricing to help guide trading decisions.
* Trading live games in real time; making quick adjustments to pricing based on game flow, key events, and customer behavior.
* Collaborating with other Traders and working cross-functionally with other teams within the Risk & Trading department or across the wider FanDuel business, in a cooperative and inclusive environment.
* Helping brainstorm new products or ways to improve the customer experience, with consideration for how fans engage with the game.

You'll work alongside experienced Traders who will guide your development. Over time, you'll gain the confidence and expertise to price markets independently, manage risk, and shape the sports betting experience for our customers.

  

**THE STATS**

What we're looking for in our next teammate

* A deep passion for NBA or WNBA (more than one league is a plus)
* A bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience. Recent or soon-to-be graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Strong comfort with numbers, odds and probability, and quick mental math skills
* It's important to understand how odds relate to probability (%), and how betting markets work in that sense. You do not have to bet yourself.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, plus the curiosity to research and stay ahead of news and trends.

* Ability to work outside typical business hours, including nights and weekends. Traders work roughly 50-70 weekend shifts per year (only ever 5 days per week)

**ABOUT FANDUEL**

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.

In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

We treat our team right

We offer generous paid time off (PTO & sick leave), annual bonus and long-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more - check out all our benefits here: **FanDuel Total Rewards**. \*Benefits differ across location, role, and level.
